The '''Tandgor system''' was located in the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the point of origin of [[Tandgor gem]]s.<ref name="PotD">{{Tales|17|Planet of the Dead}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Tandgor [[Star system/Legends|system]] was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it in grid square R-5.<ref name="TEA" />
